<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Fed rate hike impact:</strong> The US Federal Reserve’s 25 bps rate hike has pushed the rupee past the 96 mark and triggered a surge in bond yields, intensifying expectations for potential RBI policy tightening in the coming months.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W26</a></span></li>
